The '''Sith Temple on Malrev IV''' was a [[Sith temple/Legends|temple]] erected by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on [[Malrev IV]]. Malrev IV was a vital [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] hub during the [[New Sith Wars]] due to the planet being a [[Vergence/Legends|focal point for the dark side]]. The Sith constructed many temples on the planet for their [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|dark acolytes]] with only one having stood the tests of time. It focused dark side energy which could be put to use by even marginally [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals. [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] discovered the existence of Malrev IV in the [[Sith archives/Legends|Sith archives]] and dispatched a construction team to build an outpost so he could study the temple and use it to augment his own powers.<ref name="Aliens in the Empire">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/96/indexp2.html|series=Aliens in the Empire|text=Part 1: Hierarchy of Power}}</ref> Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the outpost was abandoned. One member of the construction team, a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] named [[Cartariun]], stayed behind to study the temple's power. The temple augmented his mild Force-connection, allowing him exert mental control over the native [[Irrukiine]]. Cartariun was [[Malrev incident|defeated]] by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and the temple was destroyed when Rogue pilot [[Herian I'ngre]] rammed the structure with her [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], guided by fellow Rogue [[Dllr Nep]] inside the temple.<ref name="Requiem for a Rogue">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Requiem for a Rogue]]''</ref>
